question: A can lay railway track between two given stations in 20 days and B can do the same job in 16 days. With the help of C, they did the job in 3 days only. Then, C alone can do the job in
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let **Total Work** = LCM(20, 16, 3) = **240 units**.

Efficiency: **A** = 12, **B** = 15, **A+B+C** = 80.

Efficiency of **C** = 80 − (12 + 15) = **53 units/day**.

Time for **C** = 240 ÷ 53 = **4(28/53) days**.

**∴ The correct answer is 4(28/53) days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** A = 20 days, B = 16 days, A+B+C = 3 days.

**Formula Used:** Total Work = Days × Efficiency

 
 **Person** **Days** **Total Work** **Efficiency** 
 A 20 240 12 
 B 16 15 
 A + B + C 3 80 

⇒ Efficiency of **A + B** = 12 + 15 = 27

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = (Efficiency of A + B + C) − (Efficiency of A + B)

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = 80 − 27 = 53

⇒ Time taken by **C alone** = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of C

⇒ Time = 240 ÷ 53 = 4(28/53) days

**∴ The correct answer is 4(28/53) days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Efficiency Relation

Efficiency is **inversely proportional** to the time taken to complete a task. Efficiency = Work ÷ Time.

Combined Work Formula

If A can do a job in 'x' days and B in 'y' days, together they take (x × y) ÷ (x + y) days.

LCM Method for Multiple Workers

Using the **Least Common Multiple** of individual days as the total work simplifies calculations by providing integer efficiency values.</p
